Use case: identity-preserving game animation source-frame repair. Generate ONE full-body SABLE CIRCUIT SITE-7 rifle trooper, southeast view, walk phase 3 (anatomical RIGHT foot forward contact). Output a single highly detailed native portrait 1024x1536 or larger, isolated full subject with generous uncut margins on a perfectly flat pure green #00FF00 background. No gradients, scenery, ground shadows, captions, grids, extra poses, muzzle flash or motion blur.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 is ONLY the anatomy/camera/leg-pose geometry guide. It is NOT costume, material, or visible artwork. Transfer the exact TWO leg chains and contact stance from it. The foreground brown-coded anatomical RIGHT thigh runs diagonally down-right to one knee, then one shin to the forward contact boot at screen bottom-right. The background blue-coded anatomical LEFT thigh is mostly occluded, its calf travels down-left to ONE trailing boot at screen left, heel lifted and toe contacting ground. There must be precisely TWO legs total, TWO knees total, TWO shins total, TWO ankles and TWO boots. No extra bent shin behind the foreground knee, no third boot, no branching limb or ghost silhouette. Guide colors must not appear in costume.

Image 2 is the exact approved UPPER BODY APPEARANCE AND PROJECTION authority. Retain its head scale, hood shape, visor, two gloved hands and their grip, gun, forearms, torso shape and camera angle. The full visible upper body must look like the same photographed subject from the same view as Image 2, not a new side-profile rendering. Especially preserve the SHORT THICK FORESHORTENED BULLPUP RIFLE: same stock/optic/receiver/red band/fore-end/barrel proportions, visible top surfaces and foreshortening as Image 2. Do NOT lengthen or flatten it into a thin side-on gun; do NOT change its muzzle angle relative to the head. Match its shoulder, torso and weapon projection and facing precisely.

Full lower costume continues that same trooper: hooded covered black visor/respirator, distressed black tactical cloth, scratched silver steel armor with restrained dark-red vertical markings, matching silver thigh/knee/shin plates, two black lace-up combat boots, backpack with radio antenna, utility belt. A pistol holster is strapped ONLY to the anatomical RIGHT foreground outer thigh; no left holster. Preserve Image 2 character identity, palette, weathering, realistic premium game key-art style and material detail. Armored fabric legs must follow exactly the phase-3 geometry of Image 1 without copying its primitive shapes. Stable shouldered two-handed firing hold during walking, no firing effect.

This is a full source redraw candidate, not a hard-mask or pixel-local repair. Prioritize SAME upper-body/gun view plus unambiguous two-chain anatomy. Full head, antenna, rifle muzzle and both boots wholly inside canvas. Uniform green completely behind every silhouette gap.
